    67→function _debugPastePayload(event: Event, clipboardData: DataTransfer): void {
    68→  const itemDetails = Array.from(clipboardData.items).map((item, index) => ({
    69→    index,
    70→    kind: item.kind,
    71→    type: item.type,
    72→  }));
    73→
    74→  const fileDetails = Array.from(clipboardData.files).map((file, index) => ({
    75→    index,
    76→    name: file.name,
    77→    type: file.type,
    78→    size: file.size,
    79→    lastModified: file.lastModified,
    80→    lastModifiedISO: new Date(file.lastModified).toISOString(),
    81→  }));
    82→
    83→  const typePayload: Record<string, string> = {};
    84→  for (const type of Array.from(clipboardData.types)) {
    85→    typePayload[type] = clipboardData.getData(type);
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  console.info('[MarkdownPastePlugin] paste debug payload');
    89→  console.info('event', {
    90→    type: event.type,
    91→    defaultPrevented: event.defaultPrevented,
    92→    timeStamp: event.timeStamp,
    93→  });
    94→  console.info('clipboardMeta', {
    95→    dropEffect: clipboardData.dropEffect,
    96→    effectAllowed: clipboardData.effectAllowed,
    97→    types: Array.from(clipboardData.types),
    98→    itemsCount: clipboardData.items.length,
    99→    filesCount: clipboardData.files.length,
   100→  });
   101→  console.info('items', itemDetails);
   102→  if (fileDetails.length > 0) console.info('files', fileDetails);
   103→  console.info('payloadByType', typePayload);
   104→}
   105→
   106→function convertAndInsert(markdown: string): boolean {
   107→  let conversionError: Error | null = null;
   108→  const tempEditor = createEditor({
   109→    namespace: 'markdown-paste-temp',
   110→    nodes: getResolvedEditNodes(),
   111→    onError: (error) => {
   112→      conversionError = error;
   113→    },
   114→  });
   115→
   116→  tempEditor.update(
   117→    () => {
   118→      $convertFromMarkdownString(markdown, ALL_TRANSFORMERS);
   119→    },
   120→    { discrete: true },
   121→  );
   122→
   123→  if (conversionError) {
   124→    console.error('MarkdownPastePlugin: convertAndInsert error', conversionError);
   125→    return false;
   126→  }
   127→
   128→  const serializedChildren = tempEditor.getEditorState().toJSON().root.children;
   129→  if (!serializedChildren.length) return false;
   130→
   131→  const nodes = serializedChildren.map((s: SerializedLexicalNode) => $parseSerializedNode(s));
   132→  $insertNodes(nodes);
   133→  return true;
   134→}
   135→
   136→export function MarkdownPastePlugin() {
   137→  const [editor] = useLexicalComposerContext();
   138→
   139→  useEffect(() => {
   140→    return editor.registerCommand(
   141→      PASTE_COMMAND,
   142→      (event) => {
   143→        const clipboardData =
   144→          'clipboardData' in event ? (event as ClipboardEvent).clipboardData : null;
   145→        if (!clipboardData) return false;
   146→
   147→        // debugPastePayload(event as Event, clipboardData)
   148→
   149→        // Image files → let ImageUploadPlugin handle
   150→        if (Array.from(clipboardData.files).some((f) => f.type.startsWith('image/'))) return false;
   151→
   152→        // VS Code paste → code block(s)
   153→        const vscodeData = getVSCodePasteData(clipboardData);
   154→        if (vscodeData) {
   155→          const code = clipboardData.getData('text/plain');
   156→          if (code) {
   157→            const segments = code.split(/\r?\n{3,}/).filter(Boolean);
   158→            const nodes = segments.map((s) =>
   159→              $createCodeBlockEditNode(
   160→                s.replace(/^\s*\n/, '').replace(/\n\s*$/, ''),
   161→                vscodeData.language,
   162→              ),
   163→            );
   164→            $insertNodes(nodes);
   165→            event.preventDefault();
   166→            return true;
   167→          }
   168→        }
   169→
   170→        // Rich HTML → let Lexical default handle
   171→        if (hasRichHTML(clipboardData)) return false;
   172→
   173→        // Markdown detection
   174→        const text = clipboardData.getData('text/plain');
   175→        if (!text || !detectMarkdown(text)) return false;
   176→
   177→        try {
   178→          if (!convertAndInsert(text)) {
   179→            return false;
   180→          }
   181→          event.preventDefault();
   182→          return true;
   183→        } catch {
   184→          return false;
   185→        }
   186→      },
   187→      COMMAND_PRIORITY_HIGH,
   188→    );
   189→  }, [editor]);
   190→
   191→  return null;
   192→}
   193→
````

    16→// ── Helpers ──
    17→

    19→const NEVER = /a^/;

    22→function qA(v: string): string {
    23→  return v.replaceAll('"', '\\"');

    25→
    26→function escHtml(v: string): string {
    27→  return v.replaceAll('&', '&amp;').replaceAll('<', '&lt;').replaceAll('>', '&gt;');
    28→}
    29→
    30→function escCell(v: string): string {
    31→  return v.replaceAll('|', '\\|').replaceAll('\n', '<br/>');

    33→
    34→function fence(content: string): string {
    35→  const m = content.match(/`+/g);
    36→  const max = m?.reduce((a, r) => Math.max(a, r.length), 0) ?? 0;
    37→  return '`'.repeat(Math.max(3, max + 1));
    38→}
    39→
    40→function walkText(node: Record<string, unknown>): string {
    41→  const children = node.children as Record<string, unknown>[] | undefined;
    42→  if (!children) return (node.text as string) ?? '';
    43→  return children.map(walkText).join('\n');
    44→}
    45→
    46→function stateText(state: unknown): string {
    47→  if (!state || typeof state !== 'object') return '';
    48→  const root = (state as Record<string, unknown>).root as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    49→  return root ? walkText(root) : '';
    50→}

```typescript
import type { MultilineElementTransformer } from '@lexical/markdown';
import { $createParagraphNode, $createTextNode } from 'lexical';
import {
  $createTableCellNode,
  $createTableNode,
  $createTableRowNode,
  TableCellHeaderStates,
} from '@lexical/table';

const TABLE_ROW_REG_EXP = /^\|(.+)\|\s*$/;
const TABLE_DIVIDER_REG_EXP = /^\|(\s*:?-+:?\s*\|)+\s*$/;

function parseCells(row: string): string[] {
  const match = row.match(TABLE_ROW_REG_EXP);
  if (!match) return [];
  return match[1].split('|').map((c) => c.trim());
}

export const TABLE_IMPORT_TRANSFORMER: MultilineElementTransformer = {
  dependencies: [],
  export: () => null,
  handleImportAfterStartMatch({ lines, rootNode, startLineIndex }) {
    // Need at least 2 lines (header + divider)
    if (startLineIndex + 1 >= lines.length) return null;

    // Check divider on the next line
    const dividerLine = lines[startLineIndex + 1];
    if (!TABLE_DIVIDER_REG_EXP.test(dividerLine)) return null;

    // Collect all consecutive table rows
    const headerCells = parseCells(lines[startLineIndex]);
    if (headerCells.length === 0) return null;

    let endLineIndex = startLineIndex + 1;
    const dataRows: string[][] = [];

    for (let i = startLineIndex + 2; i < lines.length; i++) {
      if (!TABLE_ROW_REG_EXP.test(lines[i])) break;
      dataRows.push(parseCells(lines[i]));
      endLineIndex = i;
    }

    // Build Lexical table
    const tableNode = $createTableNode();

    // Header row
    const headerRow = $createTableRowNode();
    for (const cell of headerCells) {
      const cellNode = $createTableCellNode(TableCellHeaderStates.ROW);
      const p = $createParagraphNode();
      p.append($createTextNode(cell));
      cellNode.append(p);
      headerRow.append(cellNode);
    }
    tableNode.append(headerRow);

    // Data rows
    for (const row of dataRows) {
      const rowNode = $createTableRowNode();
      for (let i = 0; i < headerCells.length; i++) {
        const cellNode = $createTableCellNode(TableCellHeaderStates.NO_STATUS);
        const p = $createParagraphNode();
        p.append($createTextNode(row[i] ?? ''));
        cellNode.append(p);
        rowNode.append(cellNode);
      }
      tableNode.append(rowNode);
    }

    rootNode.append(tableNode);

    return [true, endLineIndex];
  },
  regExpEnd: {
    optional: true,
    regExp: TABLE_ROW_REG_EXP,
  },
  regExpStart: TABLE_ROW_REG_EXP,
  replace: () => {},
  type: 'multiline-element',
};
```

Release @haklex/\* packages and update all downstream consumers.

## Steps

### 1. Pre-flight checks

Run `git status` in haklex repo. Ensure working tree is clean or all changes are committed. If not, stop and ask the user.

### 2. Version bump

Read current version from `packages/rich-editor/package.json` → `version` field. Default to patch bump (increment the last segment). Run:

```bash
pnpm bumpp --no-git --no-tag < patch_version > -r
```

After bumpp completes, read the new version from `packages/rich-editor/package.json` → `version` field. Store as `$NEW_VERSION`.

### 3. Build & Publish

```bash
cd < HOME > /git/repos/haklex && pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r publish --no-git-checks --filter '@haklex/*' --filter '!@haklex/rich-editor-demo'
```

`build:packages` only builds workspace packages under `packages/`; the dev playground now lives in top-level `demo/` and remains excluded from publish.

If publish fails, stop and report.

### 4. Commit and push the version bump in haklex

Stage and commit all changed `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml` files:

```
release: v$NEW_VERSION
```

Then push to remote:

```bash
git push
```

### 5. Update downstream projects

For each downstream project, update all `@haklex/*` dependency versions to `$NEW_VERSION`:

**Shiroi** — `<HOME>/git/repos/Shiroi/apps/web/package.json`

- Update `@haklex/rich-editor`, `@haklex/rich-kit-shiro`, `@haklex/rich-static-renderer`

**admin-vue3** — `<HOME>/git/repos/admin-vue3/package.json`

- Update `@haklex/rich-diff`, `@haklex/rich-ext-nested-doc`, `@haklex/rich-editor`, `@haklex/rich-editor-ui`, `@haklex/rich-kit-shiro`, `@haklex/rich-plugin-toolbar`, `@haklex/rich-style-token`

**mx-core** — `<HOME>/git/repos/mx-core/apps/core/package.json`

- Update `@haklex/rich-headless`

Use sed or Edit to replace pinned version strings. Match pattern: `"@haklex/<pkg>": "<old_version>"` → `"@haklex/<pkg>": "$NEW_VERSION"`.

### 6. Install in downstream projects

Run `pnpm install` in each downstream project root:

```bash
cd < HOME > /git/repos/Shiroi && pnpm install
cd < HOME > /git/repos/admin-vue3 && pnpm install
cd < HOME > /git/repos/mx-core && pnpm install
```

### 7. Check for new features to integrate

Compare the haklex git log since the previous version tag to identify new exports, new packages, or breaking changes:

```bash
cd < HOME > /git/repos/haklex && git log --oneline HEAD~20..HEAD
```

Scan for:

- New package exports (new entry points in `package.json` exports)
- New renderer/plugin/extension packages that downstream projects might want
- Breaking changes (renamed exports, removed APIs)

If new features are found, ask the user whether to integrate them into specific downstream projects. Do NOT auto-integrate without confirmation.

### 8. Commit and push in downstream projects

For each downstream project with changes, stage, commit, and push immediately:

```bash
# Shiroi
cd < HOME > /git/repos/Shiroi && git add -A && git commit -m "chore(deps): bump @haklex/* to $NEW_VERSION" && git push

# admin-vue3
cd < HOME > /git/repos/admin-vue3 && git add -A && git commit -m "chore(deps): bump @haklex/* to $NEW_VERSION" && git push

# mx-core
cd < HOME > /git/repos/mx-core && git add -A && git commit -m "chore(deps): bump @haklex/* to $NEW_VERSION" && git push
```

### 9. Summary

Print a table:
| Project | Version | Packages Updated | New Features |
